scripts.build: node scripts/ui/emit-svgs.mjs && tsx src/scripts/generate-icon-tones.ts && tsx src/scripts/generate-api.ts && tsx scripts/generate-feed.ts && tsx src/scripts/generate-llms-txt.ts && tsx src/scripts/generate-drawio-libraries.ts && tsx src/scripts/generate-excalidraw-libraries.ts && next build
